import random

r = random.Random(20260926)
n = 50000
m = 70000
out = [str(n) + ' ' + str(m)]
for _ in range(m):
    u = r.randint(1, n)
    v = r.randint(1, n)
    while v == u:
        v = r.randint(1, n)
    out.append(str(u) + ' ' + str(v))
print('\n'.join(out))
